title: FCL-1 commitment document (H005 carrier)
description: Syntactic schema for the JSON document carried inside the `commitments` string of a minireason.h005.artifact.v1 record. Union of (a) the grammar specified in docs/reviews/fcl1-language-proposition-2026-09-14.md and (b) what was actually observed in experiments/diagnostics/H005-open-prose-commitments/occurrence-01/artifacts/daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/*.json. Required keys follow the proposition's production; extras are ALLOWED (the harness retains, never repairs, §'Carrier and grammar'). This schema is SYNTACTIC ONLY: local-name uniqueness, reference resolution, and the `#BODY` pseudo-local-name are out-of-schema checks performed by the importer (see mapping.md).
$comment: additionalProperties:true is deliberate. Proposition: `Document := {"language":"FCL-1", "records":[Record*], "uptake":[Ref*]}` — all three keys appear in the production, so all three are required. No document-level extra key was observed in occurrence-01 (5/5 documents have exactly these three keys), but an extra key must not make a document OPAQUE: the harness retains unknown material rather than repairing it.

records.description: Record*. `Empty records or uptake are permitted.` (proposition) — minItems is therefore 0.

uptake.description: Ref*. `uptake identifies the records the author currently proposes to use. It is a local claim about standing, not a harness verdict or a truth label.` Observed: always present, always non-empty, always all-local.

LocalName.description: `Local names are unique within an authored document.` The proposition places no lexical constraint on a LocalName, so this pattern is deliberately permissive: it only excludes the empty string and the '#' separator. Observed id scheme in occurrence-01 is `^[a-z]+[0-9]+$` (c1..c3/o1/u1/p1, o1..o4, r1..r11, k1..k9, n1..n8); the reserved-looking `BODY` (see PseudoLocalName) is uppercase and is accepted here too. UNIQUENESS IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE IN JSON SCHEMA and is checked separately.

ExposedArtifactLabel.description: `<exposed artifact label>` — the label under which a projection was exposed in the rendered brief. Two interchangeable spellings were observed, both minted by the harness, never by the model: (1) the 16-hex-character prefix of trace.projection_artifacts[i].artifact_id, e.g. "b5dbbb04b5acd035"; (2) the positional alias `p.<node>.<index>`, e.g. "p.objection.0". The pattern admits both.

Ref.description: `Ref := LocalName | QualifiedName`; `QualifiedName := <exposed artifact label> "#" LocalName`. Exactly zero or one '#'. NOTE: a bare 16-hex exposed-artifact label (observed once: carry.n6.mentions[0] == "b998d514348ed94e") is lexically a LocalName and therefore VALIDATES here while failing local resolution — a semantic deviation, not a syntactic one.

Prose.description: `Prose is any JSON string.` No minLength: the proposition permits an empty string, and inventing a non-empty constraint would make the harness repair content.

Record.description: `Record := {"id":LocalName, "type":Type, "text":Prose, optional fields}`. id/type/text are required by the production; every optional field is genuinely optional (`No record type or optional field must be present.`, material.json formal_instruction).
Record.$comment: additionalProperties:true is deliberate; no record-level extra key was observed across the 42 records of occurrence-01 (observed key set is exactly {id,type,text,scope,action,consequence,grounds,bearing,target,depends,mentions}), but an unknown key must not invalidate a document.

type.description: `Type := "claim" | "commitment" | "objection" | "use" | "problem"`. Observed counts over 42 records: claim 15, use 9, objection 9, problem 5, commitment 4.

consequence.description: Observed on 13 records — 9 of them on NON-commitment records (claim/use).

grounds.description: Observed on 9 records, NONE of them of type objection.

bearing.description: Observed on 9 records — exactly the 9 objection records.

target.description: Observed on 14 records: 7 objection and 7 non-objection (claim/use).

depends.description: Observed on 11 records / 17 refs — ALL of them local (zero cross-document dependence in occurrence-01).

revises.description: Specified by the proposition; NEVER observed in occurrence-01.

withdraws.description: Specified by the proposition; NEVER observed in occurrence-01.
